title: Our Friend Joan
author: Mattie Rynkiewicz
problems: Row 3 "partners meltdown swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 5 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 8 "pass through" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.

figures.text: robins start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends
